scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Oh, it's you again.
So did you try finding
that nutcase scientist
who lives over in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
哦，又是你。找到住在吉芬的那个疯科学家了吗？

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 谈谈摩根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
You know where he lives
but didn't check it out? Hey,
he may be off his rocker, but
I guess most geniuses are
like that. Still, I think it'd be^FFFFFFss^000000 a good idea if you see him.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
你知道他住哪儿，却没去找他？嘿，他虽然有点疯，不过大多数天才大概都这样。话说回来，我觉得你最好还是^FFFFFF去^000000见见他。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
I mean...
It's only a matter
of time until a smart guy
like that creates something
truly miraculous, right?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
我是说...像他那么聪明的人，迟早会创造出真正神奇的东西，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
...Hello?
Hellooo? Hey.
Hey! I'm talkin'
to you! Man, I hate
it when you adventurers
just shut up and space out...
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
...喂？
喂——喂？嘿。
嘿！我在跟你说话呢！真讨厌，你们这些冒险者总是突然不吭声，发起呆来...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Heya.
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嗨。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Talk about the solutions.
scripts.translation: 谈谈那些溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
When I was in Geffen
looking for magic items,
I heard rumors of this really
crazy scientist guy. So I got
curious, asked around, and
eventually found this guy.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
我之前在吉芬找魔法物品时，听说有个特别古怪的科学家。我一时好奇，就四处打听，最后还真找到了他。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Boy, oh boy, this guy was
screwy. He didn't even know
I was there the whole time and
just kept mumbling this mumbo
jumbo while working on his
experiments. Words like, um...
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
天哪，那家伙真够古怪的。他一直没发现我在旁边，只顾着做实验，嘴里不停念叨些乱七八糟的话。比如什么...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Yeah, he kept mumbling
words like ''Karvodailnirol''
and ''Detrimindexta.'' The
first time I heard it, I thought
it was just crazy talk, you know?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
对，他一直念叨着“Karvodailnirol”和“Detrimindexta”之类的词。我第一次听到时还以为他在胡言乱语呢，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
But it turns out,
this Karvodailnirol
and Detrimindexta actually
exist. I think they're special
liquids that don't work quite
like any liquids we're used to.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
不过后来我才知道，Karvodailnirol和Detrimindexta确实存在。我想它们是性质特殊、不同于常见液体的溶液。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hey, this is one of
those solutions that
scientist kept mentioning.
You were able to get one
of these? Huh. Now, I have
no idea what to do with them...
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嘿，这就是那位科学家一直提到的溶液之一。你居然弄到了一份？嗯...我可不知道该拿它怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Ah, but that crazy
scientist would know.
I don't remember exactly
where he lives, but I know
he's in Geffen and that his
name is ^0000FFMorgenstein^000000.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
啊，不过那个疯科学家肯定知道。我不记得他具体住在哪里，只知道他在吉芬，名字叫^0000FF摩根斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hmm... You better
go around Geffen and
around first. I know for
ask around first. I know for
sure that somebody knows
where you can find Morgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嗯...你最好先在吉芬四处打听。我敢肯定有人知道摩根斯坦在哪儿。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Um...
Good talking
to you pal. Uh,
see ya 'round. Take
care of yourself, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嗯...和你聊得很愉快，朋友。
呃，回头见。
保重啊，好吗？

It seems that our

Coincidence? It's more
than that. This is ^0000FFfate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
看来我们的道路又一次交汇。
这是巧合吗？不，这不只是巧合，而是^0000FF命运^000000。

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 谈谈摩根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Have you not met
Morgenstein yet? He
lives on the second floor
of the Forge. Although we've
just met, I must warn you not
to get too close to him...
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
你还没见过摩根斯坦吗？他住在锻造厂二楼。虽然我们才刚认识，我还是得提醒你：别和他走得太近...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Go then, and
may the tides of
destiny carry you
to where you must go.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
去吧，愿命运的潮流带你前往该去之处。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Time flows gently
and subtly, but no
force in this world
can possibly stop it.
Mankind is not even a
mote in the grand scheme.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
时间悄然流逝，世上没有任何力量能让它停下。在宏大的天地间，人类不过是一粒尘埃。

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Ask About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 询问关于摩根斯坦的事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
To have goals and focus
is good, but to be obsessive
about one single thing can be
quite destructive. Relax, empty
your mind, and let yourself be
carried by the tides of destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
有目标并专注于此是好事，但执着于一件事可能会带来严重后果。放松下来，清空思绪，任自己随命运的潮流前行。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Morgenstein...?
The man is obsessed
with conquering the forces
that control our world. But
you seem to be curious about
him for some reason. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
摩根斯坦...？那人一心想征服支配世界的力量。不过，你似乎对他另有好奇...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
It would be best if you
were to see Morgenstein
and judge his character for
yourself. You may find him in
the second floor of the Geffen
Forge. Go: It is your destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
最好亲自去见见摩根斯坦，判断他的为人。你可以在吉芬锻造厂二楼找到他。去吧，这是你的命运。

- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！ -
- 您目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请先减轻负重 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
.....
Welcome.
Hehehehe....
Heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
...
欢迎。
嘿嘿嘿...
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: Ask about his research
scripts.translation: 询问他的研究

scripts.text: Ask him to make a new solution.
scripts.translation: 请他制作新的溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿...
你一定听说过我的研究传闻吧？没错！既然你大概已经知道了，我就不隐瞒了，反正也没什么好隐瞒的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
其实可以说我的研究已经完成了！凭我的天才，没什么是办不到的！哈哈，这只是时间问题！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
你还在这儿啊？对了，你想知道我的研究。其实很简单，我只是想发明一种能融化万物的超级液体！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
很有意思吧？不管你力气多大，都没法砸碎石头或钢铁；但有了我的新液体，就能把它们融化，变得像腻子一样软！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention. Heeheeheehee~!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
它还不能融化所有东西，不过我发现，用我的发明可以把过去无法混合的东西调和在一起。嘿嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
You can make a whole lot of things that you'd never would have imagined possible! I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
用这种方法可以做出许多你想都想不到的东西！只要你想要，我就能用它为你做出各种新玩意！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
内啡肽涌上脸颊的速度至少是平时的2.1倍！啊，我太兴奋了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
So...
You want me to make something totally new, huh? Hehhehheh! I love your sense of scientific adventure!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
所以...
你想让我做点全新的东西，是吗？嘿嘿嘿! 我喜欢你这种科学探险精神！

scripts.text: Counteragent
scripts.translation: 中和剂

scripts.text: Mixture
scripts.translation: 混合剂

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooh...!
You want to make a Counteragent? Hohohohoho, let's see what we'll need...
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
哦...！
你想制作中和剂？呵呵呵呵， 让我看看需要什么...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Oh, I remember, yes, Alcohol, and um, er, Detrimindexta and an Empty Bottle to put it it all in. Just these three items and 3000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
哦，我想起来了，没错，是酒精，还有...呃...Detrimindexta，以及一个空瓶，用来装这些东西。就这三样，再加3000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Bwahahahah!
Oh, I just can't wait to make this! Are you ready to begin?
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
哇哈哈！
我已经迫不及待要动手了！准备好开始了吗？

scripts.text: Make
scripts.translation: 制作

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heuheuheuheuh.... not enough... not enough.. Haah...Haah... Go..... get the rest of the materials!
We'll postpone the fun until then... Heuheuheuheuheuh.
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿...不够...不够...哈啊...哈啊...去...把剩下的材料找来！
等材料齐了，我们再继续...嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooooooooh...... heeheeheeheehee...... yes... like that...... yes... more... more........ heeheeheehee.
.... Aaah.... ahah... ha....ahahooooooooohoh!
scripts.translation:

哦哦...嘿嘿...是的...就这样...是的...再多点...更多...嘿嘿嘿...
啊...啊哈...哈...啊哈...哦哦哦!!!...!!!!!!

scripts.text:

Hohohoho.... not enough... not enough... haah...haah... go..... go get the rest of the materials!!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
呵呵呵...不够...还不够...哈啊...哈啊...去...把剩下的材料找来！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Hee hee hee...
Haaaaah......
Oh? We're done already?!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿...
哈啊...
哦？已经做好了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Hee hee hee...!
Come back when
you're ready~
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿...!
准备好后再回来吧~

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooh...!
You want to make a Mixture? Hohohohoho, let's see what we'll need...
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
哦...！
你想制作混合剂？呵呵呵呵， 让我看看需要什么...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooh, I remember now, yes, Alcohol, and um, er, Karvodailnirol and an empty bottle to put all of it in. Just these three items and 4000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
哦，我想起来了，没错，是酒精，还有...呃...Karvodailnirol，以及一个空瓶，用来装这些东西。就这三样，再加4000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Bwahahahah!
Oh, I just can't wait to make this! Are you ready to begin?
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
哇哈哈！
我已经迫不及待要动手了！准备好开始了吗？

嘿...嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heehee....heheheheh....
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿...嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheehee.... welcome. Hehehehe.... heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...欢迎。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ah...?!
So sorry if I weirded you out. It's just... I haven't seen a living person in soooo long. So, er, what can I do for you??
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
啊...？！
抱歉吓到你了。只是...我已经很久很久没见过活人了。那么，呃，有什么我能帮你的？

scripts.text: Ask about his research.
scripts.translation: 询问他的研究

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿...
你一定听说过我的研究传闻吧？没错！既然你大概已经知道了，我就不隐瞒了，反正也没什么好隐瞒的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
其实可以说我的研究已经完成了！以我的天才，没什么办不到的！哈哈，这只是时间问题！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
你还在这儿啊？对了，你想知道我的研究。其实很简单，我只是想发明一种能融化万物的超级液体！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
很有意思吧？不管你力气多大，都没法砸碎石头或钢铁；但有了我的新液体，就能把它们融化，变得像腻子一样柔软！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention.
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
它还不能融化所有东西，不过我发现，用我的发明可以把过去无法混合的东西调和在一起。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
用这种方法，我能做出许多你想都想不到的新东西...只要你想要！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
内啡肽涌上脸颊的速度至少是平时的2.1倍！啊，我太兴奋了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheehee...
You're not here to be a test subject, are you? Probably not though. Not since my little 'accident.' Heeheeheeee~!
scripts.translation:
[化学家摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你不是来当实验品的吧？大概不是，自从我那次小小的“意外”之后就没人来了。嘿嘿嘿嘿~！
